name_reality_gap: The index label 'Construction Repair & Maintenance Services' is seriously misleading. HDR does not build or repair infrastructure — it is an architecture, engineering, and consulting firm that designs infrastructure and manages programs. The firm itself does not hold construction contracts.
extraction_notes: Markets and services pages from hdrinc.com provided structured data on capabilities. About page confirmed firm size and values. hdrinc.com/about returned 404 initially but hdrinc.com/about-hdr worked.
